description: 写一个 html 一个鹈鹕开跑车的 svg 动画

arguments.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>鹈鹕开跑车</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#0e1621;}
  svg{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh;}
  /* 车轮旋转 */
  .wheel{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:spin .85s linear infinite;}
  @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  /* 路面虚线滚动 */
  .dashes{animation:dashmove .85s linear infinite;}
  @keyframes dashmove{to{transform:translateX(-160px)}}
  /* 云漂移 */
  .cloud1{animation:drift1 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
  .cloud2{animation:drift2 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
  @keyframes drift1{to{transform:translateX(70px)}}
  @keyframes drift2{to{transform:translateX(-90px)}}
  /* 太阳呼吸 */
  .sun{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:sunpulse 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
  @keyframes sunpulse{to{transform:scale(1.06)}}
  /* 车身悬挂颠簸 */
  .chassis{animation:bounce .4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;}
  @keyframes bounce{to{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
  /* 风线 */
  .wind{stroke:#ffffff;stroke-width:6;stroke-linecap:round;opacity:0;animation:windmove 1.2s linear infinite;}
  .wind.w2{animation-delay:.4s}
  .wind.w3{animation-delay:.8s}
  @keyframes windmove{0%{transform:translateX(0);opacity:0}15%{opacity:.85}100%{transform:translateX(-170px);opacity:0}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg viewBox="0 0 1280 800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6ec6f5"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#d9f2ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ff5252"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c62828"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="cockpitClip">
      <rect x="540" y="300" width="166" height="295"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- 背景 -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="800" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle class="sun" cx="1120" cy="110" r="80" fill="#ffd54f" opacity="0.25"/>
  <circle class="sun" cx="1120" cy="110" r="58" fill="#ffd54f"/>
  <g class="cloud1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">
    <ellipse cx="280" cy="150" rx="70" ry="26"/>
    <ellipse cx="340" cy="135" rx="55" ry="22"/>
    <ellipse cx="230" cy="135" rx="45" ry="18"/>
  </g>
  <g class="cloud2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.8">
    <ellipse cx="820" cy="230" rx="80" ry="28"/>
    <ellipse cx="890" cy="215" rx="55" ry="22"/>
    <ellipse cx="760" cy="215" rx="48" ry="18"/>
  </g>
  <text x="40" y="64" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="34" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">鹈鹕开跑车</text>

  <!-- 地面与道路 -->
  <rect x="0" y="600" width="1280" height="200" fill="#7cb86a"/>
  <circle cx="150" cy="636" r="18" fill="#5d9c52"/>
  <circle cx="1050" cy="632" r="22" fill="#5d9c52"/>
  <circle cx="1210" cy="638" r="15" fill="#5d9c52"/>
  <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="120" fill="#455a64"/>
  <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="3" fill="#90a4ae" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="0" y="757" width="1280" height="3" fill="#90a4ae" opacity="0.5"/>
  <g class="dashes" fill="#f5f5f5">
    <rect x="-160" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="0" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="160" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="320" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="480" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="640" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="800" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="960" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="1120" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="1280" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="1440" y="695" width="80" height="10" rx="5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 风线 -->
  <line class="wind w1" x1="250" y1="565" x2="370" y2="565"/>
  <line class="wind w2" x1="225" y1="610" x2="365" y2="610"/>
  <line class="wind w3" x1="250" y1="655" x2="355" y2="655"/>

  <!-- 车影 -->
  <ellipse cx="650" cy="747" rx="290" ry="11" fill="#000000" opacity="0.22"/>

  <!-- 车身（含鹈鹕，整体做悬挂颠簸） -->
  <g id="chassis" class="chassis">
    <!-- 车身轮廓：敞篷跑车 -->
    <path d="M395,665 L390,638 Q393,600 450,595 L695,595 L718,555 Q810,580 885,610 Q912,618 909,645 L902,665 Z" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>
    <!-- 下裙边暗色条 -->
    <path d="M395,650 L905,650 L902,665 L395,665 Z" fill="#8e1414" opacity="0.55"/>
    <!-- 尾翼 -->
    <path d="M398,592 L452,584 L454,592 L400,600 Z" fill="#b71c1c"/>
    <rect x="424" y="598" width="7" height="10" fill="#b71c1c"/>
    <!-- 座舱内衬 -->
    <path d="M545,595 L545,572 Q545,566 552,566 L695,566 Q702,566 702,572 L702,595 Z" fill="#37474f"/>
    <!-- 挡风玻璃 -->
    <line x1="695" y1="595" x2="718" y2="555" stroke="#cfe9f7" stroke-width="6" opacity="0.85" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- 转向柱+方向盘 -->
    <line x1="716" y1="592" x2="696" y2="570" stroke="#37474f" stroke-width="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="693" cy="568" rx="7" ry="19" fill="#263238"/>
    <!-- 鹈鹕身体+翅膀（裁剪在座舱内） -->
    <g clip-path="url(#cockpitClip)">
      <ellipse cx="620" cy="600" rx="50" ry="46" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <g id="pelicanWing">
        <ellipse cx="637" cy="567" rx="52" ry="14" fill="#e8edf1" transform="rotate(-4 637 567)"/>
        <circle cx="686" cy="563" r="11" fill="#ffffff"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <!-- 脖子+头（在车外可见） -->
    <g id="pelicanHead">
      <path d="M638,572 Q650,540 655,498" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="26" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="655" cy="490" r="34" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <path d="M678,481 L792,505 L678,501 Z" fill="#ffb300"/>
      <path d="M678,501 Q728,552 770,512 Q724,534 678,501 Z" fill="#ffa000"/>
      <circle cx="664" cy="479" r="5" fill="#263238"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 车灯/排气/门把手 -->
    <ellipse cx="893" cy="618" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#fff176"/>
    <rect x="387" y="628" width="8" height="13" rx="3" fill="#ff7043"/>
    <rect x="383" y="650" width="13" height="8" rx="2" fill="#607d8b"/>
    <rect x="572" y="612" width="24" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#a01818"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 轮拱 -->
  <path d="M416,685 A64,64 0 0 1 544,685 Z" fill="#263238"/>
  <path d="M776,685 A64,64 0 0 1 904,685 Z" fill="#263238"/>

  <!-- 后轮 -->
  <g class="wheel">
    <circle cx="480" cy="685" r="55" fill="#212121"/>
    <circle cx="480" cy="685" r="33" fill="#cfd8dc"/>
    <g stroke="#546e7a" stroke-width="6">
      <line x1="480" y1="654" x2="480" y2="716"/>
      <line x1="449" y1="685" x2="511" y2="685"/>
      <line x1="458" y1="663" x2="502" y2="707"/>
      <line x1="458" y1="707" x2="502" y2="663"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="480" cy="685" r="9" fill="#37474f"/>
  </g>
  <!-- 前轮 -->
  <g class="wheel">
    <circle cx="840" cy="685" r="55" fill="#212121"/>
    <circle cx="840" cy="685" r="33" fill="#cfd8dc"/>
    <g stroke="#546e7a" stroke-width="6">
      <line x1="840" y1="654" x2="840" y2="716"/>
      <line x1="809" y1="685" x2="871" y2="685"/>
      <line x1="818" y1="663" x2="862" y2="707"/>
      <line x1="818" y1="707" x2="862" y2="663"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="840" cy="685" r="9" fill="#37474f"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 尾气 -->
  <circle id="p0" cx="398" cy="654" r="6" fill="#cfd8dc" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle id="p1" cx="398" cy="654" r="6" fill="#cfd8dc" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle id="p2" cx="398" cy="654" r="6" fill="#cfd8dc" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
<script>
(function(){
  var head = document.getElementById('pelicanHead');
  var wing = document.getElementById('pelicanWing');
  var puffs = [document.getElementById('p0'), document.getElementById('p1'), document.getElementById('p2')];
  var ext = null; // 外部注入的虚拟时间(ms)，供录屏/转MP4使用
  function render(ms){
    var s = ms/1000;
    // 头部上下轻摆 + 微微点头
    var bobY = Math.sin(s*4.2)*3;
    var rot = Math.sin(s*2.6)*3.5;
    head.setAttribute('transform','translate(0,'+bobY.toFixed(2)+') rotate('+rot.toFixed(2)+',652,555)');
    // 翅膀/手握方向盘轻轻打方向
    var wr = Math.sin(s*5.1)*5;
    wing.setAttribute('transform','rotate('+wr.toFixed(2)+',590,570)');
    // 尾气一串串向后飘散
    for(var i=0;i<3;i++){
      var ph = (s*1.4 + i/3) % 1;
      puffs[i].setAttribute('cx',(398 - ph*120).toFixed(1));
      puffs[i].setAttribute('cy',(654 + Math.sin(ph*7)*5).toFixed(1));
      puffs[i].setAttribute('r',(5 + ph*11).toFixed(1));
      puffs[i].setAttribute('opacity',((1-ph)*0.5).toFixed(2));
    }
  }
  window.__setAnimTime = function(ms){ ext = ms; render(ms); };
  var t0 = null;
  function loop(ts){
    if(ext !== null){ render(ext); requestAnimationFrame(loop); return; }
    if(t0 === null) t0 = ts;
    render(ts - t0);
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
